resolutions.researcher_notes: OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin 2013, p.79 (via Wayback; opec.org original now 403), Table 4.10 'Gas pipelines in OPEC Members, 2012' lists this segment as an in-service (existing) line -> supports Status=operating. Row: 'UBTG-1 km 56/AY-1 KP 916, Saudi Aramco, 152 miles, 56 inches'. Inclusion in the operating gas-pipelines table is indirect support for operating status; single publisher (OPEC), no independent second source found for this internal Aramco KP-designated segment -> medium.
Row appears in OPEC ASB2013 Table 4.10 'Gas pipelines in OPEC Members' -> supports Fuel=Gas. Single OPEC-family source; medium.

OPEC ASB2013 p.79 gives length 152 miles for 'UBTG-1 km 56/AY-1 KP 916'. 152 mi = 244.6 km, matching LengthKnown=244.00 km (source is in miles; GEM converted). Note: gem.wiki page states 245 km; 244 km is the closer conversion of 152 mi. Single OPEC-family source; medium.
OPEC ASB2013 p.79 lists diameter 56 inches for 'UBTG-1 km 56/AY-1 KP 916' -> exactly matches Diameter=56 in. Single OPEC-family source; medium.

Row is under the 'Saudi Arabia' country heading in OPEC ASB2013 Table 4.10 -> supports Start/EndCountryOrArea=Saudi Arabia. Endpoints are internal Aramco kilometer-point designations (UBTG-1 km 56 and AY-1 KP 916), both within Saudi Arabia; no city/prefecture granularity in GEM row. Single OPEC-family source; medium.

OPEC ASB2013 p.79 'Owner or operator' column reads 'Saudi Aramco' for this segment -> supports Owner1=Saudi Aramco (100%). Table conflates owner/operator, but Aramco is the sole owner-operator of the Saudi Master Gas System trunk lines. Single OPEC-family source; medium.
